sections.title: How the population has changed in Sheffield
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Sheffield was the third largest local authority in Yorkshire and The Humber, with a population of just over 580,000. Its population increased by 1.2% compared with 2023, and has increased by 13.5% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in Yorkshire and The Humber, 2001-2024
Population density in Sheffield
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Sheffield was 1,583 people per square kilometre, which was more than Yorkshire and The Humber (368), and more than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in Yorkshire and The Humber, 2024
Median age in Sheffield
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Sheffield was 36 years, which was younger than Yorkshire and The Humber (40 years), and younger than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
